description.value: Mui Ngo Gai is a Vietnamese and Singaporean fusion restaurant on Vancouver's Kingsway corridor, blending the bold flavors of two Southeast Asian culinary traditions under one roof. Chefs from Vietnam and Singapore bring regional authenticity to dishes spanning pho, Singaporean specialties, and a broad range of vegetarian options. The restaurant accepts reservations and offers online ordering, making it a versatile stop for touring cyclists along this busy urban route.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and confirms the business name, address, and phone number not present in OSM. The website explicitly lists a 'Vegetarian' section in navigation and gallery filters, confirming vegetarian menu options. An 'Order Online' feature is prominently displayed, supporting takeout availability; no bike-specific amenities (racks, wi-fi, charging) are mentioned anywhere in the website or OSM tags.
concerns: OSM has no phone number; (604) 876-8885 was taken from the website only — contact_confirmed.phone set to null.
OSM opening_hours tag (We-Mo 10:00-23:00; Tu off) conflicts with website, which lists Tuesday as an open day — OSM hours data appears outdated.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active, well-established restaurant on a major Vancouver cycling corridor with confirmed vegetarian menu and online ordering; a practical food stop for touring cyclists, pending on-site verification of bike parking.
